{{Quote|We have no time to waste, so I'll get right to it. Terrorists have attacked this section of Theed. We need to neutralize the terrorists and aid in recovering from the attack.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harvin Franchels|Franchels]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HwtAotTA" />}}
A '''terrorist attack''' took place in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A large amount of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] deployed in a full district of the city and placed chemical bombs in the streets. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harvin Franchels|Franchels]] was the RSF officer in charge of the situation during the attack in Theed. Even after the initial attack, many terrorists remain in the part of the city that suffered the attack. Major Franchels tasked his agents to eliminate the remaining terrorists, disarm the bombs and deliver medical supplies to use on victims of the attack.<ref name="SWG:HwtAotTA" /> After the situation was fixed, [[RSF Intelligence Division|RSF Intelligence]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] was charged to investigate the attack to find the identity of the culprits as nobody had claimed responsibility. He discovered that the [[Mummers]] were responsible,<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> leading to a RSF [[Raid on the Mummer bunker|raid]] on the [[Mummer bunker]].<ref name="SWG:BTttT" />
